name: react-email
title_zh: React 组件写邮件模板，还带可嵌入的可视化编辑器
tagline_zh: 欢迎信、找回密码、订单确认这些邮件，终于不用在 table 嵌套里手写内联样式了。
tagline_en: Welcome emails, password resets, order confirmations — no more hand-writing inline styles inside nested tables.
desc_en: Use when building HTML email templates with React components, adding a visual email editor to an application using the React Email visual editor, rendering emails to HTML, or sending emails with Resend. Covers welcome emails, password resets, notifications, order confirmations, newsletters, transactional emails, and the embeddable email editor component.
why_zh: 组件即模板，预览和渲染走同一份代码，所见即所发；编辑器是现成组件而不是另开一套后台。
why_en: The component is the template — preview and render share one source, so what you see is what sends. The editor ships as a.
limit_zh: 只服务 React/Next.js 项目，Vue 或纯后端模板引擎用不上。
limit_en: React/Next.js only — no Vue or server-side template engines. You still need to test client compatibility yourself; Outlook desktop quirks aren't.
title_en: React components for email templates, plus an embeddable.
